info.name: Group Manager
info.summary: Manage local and LDAP groups, their members and group folders from one screen
info.description:
Group Manager gives administrators a single screen to browse groups (local and LDAP), manage local group membership in bulk, and — when Team Folders is installed — create or assign group folders and their per-group permissions and quota, without leaving Settings.
- Browse local and LDAP/AD groups side by side, searchable, with LDAP groups grouped separately. - Add people, a whole group at once, or a pasted list to a local group; queue several changes as colored chips and apply them in one batch that never aborts over a single failed row. - Create a new group folder or assign an existing one to a group, edit Write/Share/Delete permissions and the folder's quota, and see a badge when a folder has advanced permissions (ACL) enabled — works for LDAP groups too. - LDAP group membership stays read-only, as the directory is the source of truth; everything else works the same as for a local group.
info.author: Ricardo Ferreira
